en: Fixed sessions continued after `/clear` (restart, `--continue`, `--resume`) missing part of their first message when a SessionStart hook printed output, causing a full prompt-cache miss
zh: 修复了在 `/clear` 之后继续的 session（重启、`--continue`、`--resume`）在 SessionStart hook 输出内容时丢失首条消息部分内容，导致 prompt 缓存完全未命中的问题
